free_design.Place: a sunny outdoor miniature railway museum with a parked historic carriage
free_design.Activity: she plays the volunteer station host and raises a small brass departure bell; the fitted detachable shoulder cape has folded back as she lifts her arm, revealing her bare upper arms while the opaque uniform remains secure
free_design.Pose: standing three-quarter toward the viewer; right elbow bent beside her ribs and right hand holding the bell at chest height, left arm descending naturally and left hand holding a blank ticket wallet at her waist
free_design.Framing: head to knees, natural chest-height camera, face and both hands clearly visible
free_design.Outfit: an original ivory-and-coral station-host roleplay uniform with a short fitted double-breasted waistcoat, deep V opaque inset, tailored short culottes, tiny detachable shoulder cape and low ankle boots; bare arms and upper thighs, securely covered intimate areas
